profile.headline: at
profile.summary:
Highly motivated Senior Software Engineer with over 15 years of experience in web development, database development, applications development, network engineering, and enterprise application integration.  Demonstrated success in the design, development, and deployment of software for several federal government and military organizations.  Extensive expertise in developing web applications using .NET technologies and database development using SQL Server.  Experienced team leader with advanced debugging knowledge and excellent technical and communication skills.  Very detail-oriented individual with great problem solving and multitasking ability.

Specialties: Programming Languages:  VB.NET, ASP.NET, ADO.NET, SQL, HTML/DHTML, JavaScript, CSS, VBScript, Classic ASP, XML, XSL, XSLT, C/C++, Servlets;  Applications:  MS Visual Studio, Borland JBuilder, webMethods;  Web Application Servers:  MS Internet Information Services (IIS), Apache;  Database Technologies: MS SQL Server Management Studio, Crystal Reports 11, Oracle 9i/10g Enterprise, Microsoft Access

positions.title: Senior Subject Matter Expert/Team Lead
positions.description:
SME/Team Lead - Web/Database Development. Manage, develop software, and provide lifecycle support for two major language training web applications that provide access to a broad range of materials at all levels of proficiency. Available resources consist of over 2,300 periodicals from 100 countries in 60 languages that are updated daily. The applications have over 100,000 combined users.
•	Manage team of up to 5, which includes developers and a system administrator
•	Provide technical direction, work assignments, status tracking and reporting
•	Directly coordinate with customers to obtain new requirements
•	Develop functional requirements, system requirements, and system engineering documentation
•	Develop web applications using ASP, CSS, JavaScript, JQuery, and VBScript, with SQL Server back-end databases. Software runs on IIS and Windows servers
•	Manage redesign of existing Classic ASP applications to use MVC.NET and C#.NET
•	Provide help desk support

positions.title: Lead .Net Developer/Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical Lead – Web/Database Development.  Develop and maintain ASP.NET web applications for the United States Army. These applications tie back-end SQL Server databases to front-end web pages with the use of VB.NET, ASP.NET, ADO.NET, JavaScript, HTML/DHTML, CSS, and Crystal Reports. 
•	Design, develop, modify, test, and deploy web applications using Microsoft Visual Studio .NET 2003/2005/2010. 
•	Create and modify database tables, stored procedures, views, user defined functions, and triggers using Microsoft SQL Server 2000/2005. 
•	Create, modify, and test Crystal Reports using Crystal Reports 10. 
•	Configure web servers and virtual websites using Microsoft Internet Information Services. 
•	Maintain source control integrity using Microsoft Visual Source Safe. 
•	Provide technical support and delegate tasks to other project team members. 
•	Serve as the lead developer. 

Web/Database Development.  Developed web applications and designed/modified databases for the United States Coast Guard in a Windows environment.  Utilized knowledge of database servers, J2EE, HTML, Java, JavaScript, MS Internet Information Services, OBDC, Oracle 9i and 10g Enterprise, PERL, Server Backup capabilities, SQL, SQLServer 2000, Windows Server 2003 and Web Services. 
•	Designed, developed, modified, and tested web applications. 
•	Created and modified database tables, stored procedures, views, user defined functions, and triggers using Microsoft SQL Server 2000, Oracle 9i and Oracle 10g Enterprise. 
•	Configured database and web servers. 
•	Converted entire Oracle database to SQL Server database.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Web Development/Technical Support.  Developed web applications for a Navy budgeting system. Development was done using JBuilder in a Windows environment.  Utilized knowledge of J2EE, JDBC, HTML, handling client requests, generating server responses, session tracking, and writing code using Applets, HTML, Java, JavaBeans, JavaScript, JSP, Servlets, SQL, XML, and XSLT. 
• Designed, developed, modified, and tested web applications. 
• Provided customer service and technical support to users. 

Applications Development.  Developed software for the DoD Electronic Business Exchange (DEBX). 
• Created applications using C and C++ in a UNIX environment. 
• Participated in multiple code reviews. 
• Conducted regression testing. 

Hardware/Network Engineering.  Installed and configured HP Proliant DL 380 and 580 rack servers.  Loaded and configured Windows Server 2003 Enterprise/Standard Edition and Window XP Professional.  Utilized knowledge of Client Security, Disk Management, Domain Name System (DNS) Configuration, HP Proliant Essentials Foundation Pack, LAN Administration, Norton Ghost 8, Server Clustering, Server Management, Routers, SNMP, Switches, and User Account Administration.

positions.title: Associate Satellite Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Technical member of a rotating shift engineering team dedicated to supporting several complex systems relating to satellite communications. 
•	Was responsible for the preparation and execution of all processes and actions necessary for maintaining a healthy real-time environment and operations. 
•	Directed state of health monitoring and maintenance activities, including command and control of highly sophisticated hardware/software systems. 
•	Assisted and supported anomaly resolution. 
•	Provided thorough data analysis and interacted with other support organizations, when necessary. 
•	Provided practical training to new employees.
